Class SimulationProfiler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.profiling.SimulationProfiler
public class SimulationProfiler extends Object
High-precision micro-profiler for Ether simulation ticks. Measures tick durations, phase breakdowns (in nanoseconds/microseconds), and calculates min/max/avg/P95 latency stats and TPS.
